records.name: Indiana Native American Indian Affairs Commission
records.what: The state body for issues affecting Native American Indian communities in Indiana. Its work now continues as the Native American Indian Affairs Subcommittee of the Indiana Cultural Commission.
records.who: Native American Indian people and communities in Indiana.
